definitions: A long, thin, flat piece of wood or other hard material, used for floors or other building purposes.
A flat piece of material, typically wood or plastic, used for a specific purpose, such as a cutting board or a chessboard.
A group of people constituted as the decision-making body of an organization.
Daily meals, especially as provided for payment with lodging.
A flat surface, often with information written or displayed on it, for public viewing.
examples: She chopped the vegetables on the board.
The board of directors met yesterday.
He pays for his room and board.
Look at the notice board for details.
